# REinfinite Group Ltd
> Quantitative real estate firm. Institutional capital deployed through closed-end fund vehicles across UK and European markets.

## About
REinfinite Group Ltd is a quantitative real estate firm. It deploys institutional capital into UK and European real estate through closed-end fund vehicles. The Group operates four divisions: development and construction, investment management, asset stewardship, and quantitative research.

## Divisions
- Development & Construction: biophilic and neuroarchitectural development, precision delivery and lifecycle stewardship
- Investment Management: closed-end fund vehicles, value-add and opportunistic
- Asset Stewardship: long-term asset management, ESG benchmarking
- Quantitative Research: InfiniVerde Ltd — closed-source quantitative research across 30+ markets

## Investment Approach
Capital allocation follows a single pipeline. Every opportunity passes through the Group's quantitative modelling platform before capital is committed. The benchmarks that approved the investment are the same that monitor it. The Group co-invests from its own balance sheet in every vehicle it sponsors.

## Target Investors
Institutional allocators, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and qualified private investors.

## Philosophy
Capital is allocated where a quantitative thesis meets structural conviction. Capital preservation is a design constraint, not a preference. Capital follows conviction. Conviction follows evidence.
